subject: Sampling message 'gaussian(identity) brms-model' for negative binomial GLMM

messages.author: 8aa5ba2754a253a4
messages.subject: Sampling message 'gaussian(identity) brms-model' for negative binomial GLMM
parts:
Hello, 

When I run a brm model with family = negbinomial(), I get the following message during sampling:

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'gaussian(identity) brms-model' NOW


What does the "gaussian" mean and is this normal for a negative binomial GLMM?


Thanks!
Hao Ran

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] Sampling message 'gaussian(identity) brms-model' for negative binomial GLMM
parts:
Hi Hao Ran,

this is a bug in the printing. The model that is actually fit is correct, that is a negbinomial model in your case.

I just fixed the printing in the dev version of brms from github.

Thanks for pointing me to it!
